title: Kuro Matcha Latte Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid  By Riot
description: Kuro Matcha Latte Nic Salt E-Liquid by Riot Labs offers a deeply layered and sophisticated vaping experience inspired by modern Japanese cafe culture. This expertly crafted blend provides a soothing and authentic take on a beloved beverage, featuring the distinct, earthy notes of Sweet Matcha green tea. To balance the botanical base, rich layers of Condensed Milk and warm Vanilla are folded in, creating an exceptionally smooth and creamy exhale. The result is a superbly balanced profile that offers a mature, nuanced alternative to standard fruit e-liquids. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The versatile 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. Kuro Nicotine Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The wider Kuro collection by Riot Labs takes inspiration from modern Japanese food and drink culture to offer a uniquely crafted range of e-liquids. Moving beyond standard profiles, the collection invites vapers to explore premium blends such as the delicately layered Momo Fuji, the zesty Tokyo Mule, or the complex, floral notes of Sakura Nights. Each carefully balanced e-liquid provides a distinct flavour journey for those seeking a highly original, premium vape.
